description: This file defines a React component named ProtectedRoute that acts as a guard for nested routes, ensuring that only authenticated users with appropriate roles can access certain parts of the application. It manages user authentication state, loading state, and access control behavior.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute({ requiredRole })
methods.description: React functional component that renders nested routes if the user is authenticated and has the required role; otherwise, redirects or shows loading states.
